# sonarqube_permission_templates (Data Source)

Lists permission templates, sorted by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_permission_templates" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `search` (String) Case-insensitive partial match on the template name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup in Terraform state.
- `permission_templates` (Attributes List) Matching templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permission_templates))

<a id="nestedatt--permission_templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permission_templates`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Template description.
- `id` (String) Template ID.
- `name` (String) Template name.
- `project_key_pattern` (String) Pattern of project keys the template applies to, or null.
